settings.question: How should I film my swing?
settings.answer: Phone at hip height, face-on, ball on a tee — portrait clips straight off a phone work fine. Down-the-line clips get tempo & rhythm only for now; film face-on for the full report.

settings.question: Do I need to trim the clip first?
settings.answer: No. Upload the whole clip — CaddieInsight listens for audible strikes and separates detected swings automatically. If a strike is not audible or detection misses it, you can supply a manual strike time.

settings.question: Why do I have to choose a club?
settings.answer: For irons, hybrids, fairway woods, and drivers, supported club context helps rank responsible coaching. CaddieInsight requires the club before upload and keeps it with the report. A wedge is stored and used for matched comparisons, but its coaching remains neutral until shot intent and lie are captured.

settings.question: Can I delete my swing history and start over?
settings.answer: Yes. Your account includes a deliberate delete-history flow so you can remove prior sessions and restart your practice record.

settings.question: What does the free plan include?
settings.answer: One full swing analysis per calendar month, free forever. It produces the complete report: metrics table, key-position strip, centerline overlay, slow motion, and coaching notes. Pro adds unlimited filming, the annotated coach replay, and the progress dashboard.

settings.question: How does Pro unlock after I buy it here?
settings.answer: Pro connects to the CaddieInsight account linked to your purchase email. After checkout, open the app to sign in or finish account setup; access activates when the paid order is confirmed.

settings.question: Does it work for left-handed golfers?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your handedness when you upload, and every measurement, overlay, and coaching note is computed for a left-handed swing.

settings.question: How long does gear take to arrive?
settings.answer: Training aids ship from partner warehouses. Orders are processed in 1–2 business days and U.S. delivery typically takes 6–12 business days, with tracking emailed at dispatch.

settings.question: What if a training aid isn't right for me?
settings.answer: Unused gear may be returned within 30 days. See the Shipping & Returns page for eligibility and instructions.

settings.question: Can I get a refund on Pro?
settings.answer: CaddieInsight Pro and other digital services are refundable within 14 days of purchase if unused.
